notes.title: Free Content Update: V1.01
notes.content:
[b]v1.01 Hard Mode Patch[/b]
Changes
[list]
[*] - Added Chinese (Traditional and Simplified) localization
[*] - [b]Added Hard Mode[/b]
                 	- Energy level resets to 0 when taken damage
                	- Chain attacking combo counter
                	- New scoring system 
                	- New Boss abilities
[*] - Improved score display
[*] - Improved tutorial level
[*] - Added a new Hidden Boss
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] - Fixed attack hitbox stays active after dashing/double jumping mid air attack
[*] - Fixed issue with lock on near Boss arena wall
[*] - Fixed player sometimes gaining Energy twice from a single enemy kill
[*] - Fixed transparent energy pop up letter stuck on screen
[*] - Fixed dash attack sometimes doesn't connect
[*] - Fixed camera poking out ceiling
[*] - Fixed player sliding or sinking into ground in cutscene
[*] - Fixed hint not showing properly with teleporter
[*] - Fixed Level 02 BGM out of sync
[*] - "Point" is now reworded to "Energy"
[*] - Enemy now respawns in certain area to prevent softlock
[/list]

notes.title: v1.00.05
notes.content:

[*] Score menu now runs faster
[*] Improved skip prompt
[/list]
